# `unnecessaryTypeofType`

Suggests replacing typeof Schema.Type style annotations with the matching named type when available

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377090` |
| Language Service name | `unnecessaryTypeofType` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/unnecessary-typeof-type` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Schema } from "effect"

export namespace UsersRepo {
  export const User = Schema.Struct({ id: Schema.Finite })
  export type User = typeof User.Type
}

export const preview: typeof UsersRepo.User.Type = { id: 1 }
/**
                      ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(unnecessary-typeof-type): This `typeof ... .Type` query can be replaced with `UsersRepo.User`.
*/
```
